Flapping Airplanes raised $180M from GV, Sequoia, and Index to prove that AI models can 'think at human level' on a fraction of today's training data. As sample-efficiency research becomes the next frontier of foundation-model IP, startups in this space face early-stage patent strategy questions — not just what to claim, but where the boundary lies between algorithmic methods (patentable in some jurisdictions) and abstract ideas (excluded in others). The AI Patent Strategy Scorecard helps early-stage AI labs navigate that landscape before competitors file foundational claims.
